messages:
michael: Heads up — Shoreline Dedicated customer cutover proposed for Sat 04:00 UTC. Need final go/no-go and version pin for the dedicated GPU pool.
sofia: Ack. Can we confirm the model variant and quantization level we pin? last time float16 caused perf blips. :grimacing:
ashok: Recommend pinning to model v1.4.2, q4_0 profile. We ran perf runs yesterday: 120ms p50, 700ms p99 on dedicated slice.
carol: Agree v1.4.2 + q4_0. Suggest canary at 10% for 30m then 50% for 15m before full shift. Rollback if error rate > 2% or latency p99 > 1s sustained 5m.
deploy-bot: Deploy plan uploaded: job 823174. Steps:
```
# canary
deploy --target=shoreline-dedicated --model=shoreline:v1.4.2 --quant=q4_0 --traffic=10% --duration=30m
# ramp
deploy --ramp-to=50% --duration=15m
deploy --switch --duration=5m
```
Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/job/823174
sofia: Monitoring dashboards? need endpoints for oncall to watch.
ops-bot: Canary dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/shoreline/canary
ops-bot: Alert policies attached: latency_p99, error_rate_5m, mem_oom_rate. Pager thresholds set to ops oncall if error_rate > 2.5%.
michael: @sofia @ashok @carol please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the canary plan and thresholds. If anyone needs extra rollback criteria speak up now.
sofia: :thumbsup: approve.
ashok: :thumbsup: approve. I'll be watching memory and KV cache hit rate.
carol: :thumbsup: approve. Add a post-cutover smoke test: run 50 synthetic requests via /smoke endpoint.
michael: Good call — adding smoke test to deploy job.
deploy-bot: Updated job 823174: smoke test step + rollback hook configured. Rollback command: `deploy rollback --job=823174 --to=shoreline:v1.4.1`
sofia: FYI — inform Shoreline customer success lead (cc @carol) about expected brief 2–3 minute degradation during final switch.
carol: I'll send the customer note now. Template: short maintenance window + contact + rollback SLA.
michael: Final checklist: 1) Approvals (done) 2) Ops oncall staffed (ashok) 3) Monitoring links (ops-bot provided) 4) Rollback pinned (deploy-bot) 5) Post-cutover smoke (added).
michael: Scheduling: I'll trigger canary Sat 04:00 UTC. If any blocker before 03:30 UTC call abort.
ashok: I'll be on standby at 03:45 UTC.
sofia: Oncall handover noted.
carol: Customer notified.
michael: Ok launching per plan unless anyone posts a blocker. Otherwise marking this thread as go. :rocket:
